import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def _norm_sku(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return pd.NA
    return str(s).strip().upper()


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    price_list = inputs["price_list"].copy()

    # ---- exp: derive sku_norm ----
    orders["sku_norm"] = orders["sku"].apply(_norm_sku)

    # keep track of original row order
    orders = orders.reset_index(drop=True)
    orders["_orig_idx"] = orders.index

    # ---- lkp: lookup price_list ----
    price_list = price_list.copy()
    price_list["sku_norm_pl"] = price_list["sku"].apply(_norm_sku)

    # only rows with non-null sku_norm can possibly match
    candidates = orders[orders["sku_norm"].notna()]

    merged = candidates.merge(
        price_list,
        left_on="sku_norm",
        right_on="sku_norm_pl",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("", "_pl"),
    )

    # condition: valid_from <= order_date
    merged = merged[merged["valid_from"] <= merged["order_date"]]

    # tie-break: greatest valid_from, then lowest list_id
    merged = merged.sort_values(
        by=["_orig_idx", "valid_from", "list_id"],
        ascending=[True, False, True],
        kind="mergesort",
    )
    best = merged.drop_duplicates(subset="_orig_idx", keep="first")
    best = best[["_orig_idx", "unit_price"]]

    orders = orders.merge(best, on="_orig_idx", how="left", suffixes=("", "_lkp"))

    orders["price_flag"] = np.where(orders["unit_price"].notna(), "OK", "NO_PRICE")
    orders["unit_price"] = orders["unit_price"].fillna(0)

    # ---- ext: ext_amount = qty * unit_price ----
    qty_isna = orders["qty"].isna()
    orders["ext_amount"] = orders["qty"] * orders["unit_price"]
    orders.loc[qty_isna, "ext_amount"] = np.nan

    # ---- rtr: router (ordered rules, first true wins) ----
    cond_review = (orders["price_flag"] == "NO_PRICE") | qty_isna | (
        (~qty_isna) & (orders["qty"] >= 100)
    )

    ext_notna = orders["ext_amount"].notna()
    cond_bulk = ext_notna & (orders["ext_amount"] >= 1000)
    cond_small = ext_notna & (orders["ext_amount"] < 50)

    route = np.full(len(orders), "STANDARD", dtype=object)

    # apply in reverse priority order so earlier rules overwrite later ones
    route = np.where(cond_small, "SMALL", route)
    route = np.where(cond_bulk, "BULK", route)
    route = np.where(cond_review, "REVIEW", route)

    orders["route"] = route

    # ---- out1: order_enriched ----
    order_enriched = orders[["order_id", "sku_norm", "unit_price", "route"]].copy()

    # ---- agg: aggregator grouped by route, order_date ----
    grouped = orders.groupby(["route", "order_date"], dropna=False)

    order_count = grouped.size().rename("order_count")
    total_ext = grouped["ext_amount"].sum(min_count=1).rename("total_ext")
    total_ext = total_ext.fillna(0)

    agg_df = pd.concat([order_count, total_ext], axis=1).reset_index()

    route_daily = agg_df[["route", "order_date", "order_count", "total_ext"]].copy()

    return {
        "order_enriched": order_enriched,
        "route_daily": route_daily,
    }
